assets.note: DTC_hull.igs measured 2026-11-17 (mission m21785): IGES unit flag 6 = metres, full scale; half-breadth field gives displacement 173459.0 m3 vs published 173467.5 m3 (-0.005 %), Cb 0.6607 vs 0.661 (-0.045 %), beam 51.0022 m vs 51.0 m (+0.004 %). The appendage files (rudder_skeg, bilgekeel) are imported for completeness and are NOT geometrically measured here. Record benchmarks/verified/fleet_refs/dtc_hull_measured.json, tool tools/baseline_fleet/dtc_hull_measure.py. The earlier 'IGES sampling collapses to a point' withdraw is stale: it predates the type-128 control-net layout fix in tensorcad.iges._split_control.
